column1: # Sky-position regression corpus for the direction cascade: the
# canonical high-PM set (tier-1 Gaia) plus one pin per non-Gaia tier —
# Sirius/Vega for tier 2 (hip2_saturated, the Gaia-saturated bright
# set), xi UMa for tier 3 (athyg_printed).
# Positions are at the J2016.0 scene epoch (CATALOG_SCENE_EPOCH):
# - Gaia tier: the raw Gaia DR3 catalog ra/dec, whose native epoch IS
#   J2016.0 — so the cascade's propagation is a Δt=0 no-op here. These
#   rows therefore pin source-id selection, tier routing, and xyz
#   assembly (a wrong source or a sign flip shows up as tens of arcsec),
#   NOT the propagation formula. That formula (PM sign / cos delta /
#   Δt direction) is exercised by the 24.75-yr HIP2 tier below and
#   pinned independently against SIMBAD J2000 in direction-cascade.test.ts.
# - Sirius/Vega (tier 2): van-Leeuwen-2007 J1991.25 PM-propagated 24.75
#   yr forward to J2016.0 — this DOES exercise the propagation.
# - xi UMa (tier 3, athyg_printed): AT-HYG's printed ra/dec is used
#   UNPROPAGATED (no Gaia source, HIP 55203 excluded from HIP2), so it
#   sits at AT-HYG's native ~J2000 epoch regardless of the scene epoch;
#   its GJ-anchored coord is good to a couple of arcsec against SIMBAD's
#   UCAC4 coordinate, so it pins loose at 3.0".
# lookup: hip where the AT-HYG row carries one; xi UMa's row carries
# neither HIP nor Gaia (that is precisely why it routes tier 3), so it
# is addressed by proper name and its hip cell is blank.
